generalCriterionList.description: Qualified tenderer should provide information & documents related to skilled and experienced manpower and machinery
Forest Contractor Certificate issued by any Forest division in Karnataka for the year 2026-27
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Satisfactory Work Done Certificate corresponding to the tendered work in last five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26)

Satisfactory Work Done Certificate issued for piece work contracts or any other means of contracts will not be considered. The said certificate shall be corresponding only to the work orders obtained as prime contractor in e-procurement only as a successful tenderer
Assessed available tender capacity & existing commitments
Annual Turnover Certificate and Audited Balance Sheet for the last three financial years (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) with copies of Income Tax Returns for the above period shall be submitted

Availability of credit facilities of not less than 30% of the amount of contract in the form of Bank Certificates / Letter of Credit with work indent number in the favour of tender to DCF Forest Division, BDA by any nationalized bank having jurisdiction of Bangalore
Certificate/Letter attested by any officer belonging to group A services or equivalent in rank
EPF/ESI Registration Certificate Remittance acknowledgement,PAN Card, GST Registration Certificate, IT Returns Acknowledgement, GST Clearance Certificate, Address proof

Tenderers should not be in the Blacklist/Debarred list by Employer/Karnataka Forest Department/Govt. body/PSU/Owner at the time of applying for tender due to poor performance or corrupt and fraudulent practices or any other reason in the past. Further, neither bidder nor their allied agency ies (as defined in the Procedure for Action in case of Corrupt/ Fraudulent/Collusive/ Coercive Practices) should be on the Blacklist of Employer/Karnataka Forest Department/Govt.body/PSU/Owner
